title: get-class-const-arg (clean-room semantics)

ground_truth.statement: get_class selects the actual class, so each switch branch calls a method present on its receiver.

allowed.reason: Both final-class alternatives return in the switch. The fallback throw is genuinely unreachable.

notes: The local source is a lead, not an oracle. Fixture and deterministic controls are re-derived from PHP semantics. Constant-condition diagnostics measure broad behavior, not a recommendation that every redundancy deserves a product warning. Measured with PHP 8.3.35, PHPStan 2.3.1, Psalm 6.20.0 and Mago 1.57.0. phpstan agrees with the scoped expectation; psalm agrees with the scoped expectation; mago false_positive: unexpected diagnostic(s): non-existent-method@7, non-existent-method@8.
